name: Paddle MCP
description: Lets agents query and manage Paddle Billing products, prices, subscriptions, customers, and transactions through a hosted MCP server that searches and chains API calls.

skills.name: API Search
skills.description: Looks up Paddle API methods by name or description and returns the method path, parameters, and response shape.

skills.name: Chained API Execution
skills.description: Runs a JavaScript async function that chains several Paddle API calls in one invocation, with warnings on destructive operations.

skills.name: Metrics Charts
skills.description: Draws a Paddle metric as an interactive chart in AI clients that support MCP Apps.

skills.name: Sandbox Environment
skills.description: Connects to a separate sandbox server with a sandbox API key so agents can test, then port a catalog to live.

skills.name: Scoped Permissions
skills.description: Starts OAuth connections with read access and lets you widen or revoke them under Paddle > Connectors > MCPs.
